title: Rozadaro Khaak Udao
body:
ay rozadaro khaak udao
taboot uth raha hai janabe ameer ka
is din ko bhi ashoor banao
taboot uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain se karti thi buka zainab e kubra
taaza tha abhi madar e dilgeer ka sadma
ab daagh yateemi ka uthao
taboot uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek samt se taboot uthayenge farishte
aur mehwe buka doosri jaanib se hai bete
salman o abuzar ko bulao
taboot uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye gham bine muljim ne diya aal e nabi ko
sajde mein kiya qatl mere baba ali ko
ay logon mera dard battao
taboot uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ne dam e rukhsat e aakhir ye kaha tha
abbas hai zaamin meri zainab ki rida ka
ghazi ko ye ehsaas dilao
taboot uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
taboot mera naaqe pe kar dena rawana
ruk jaye jahan naaqa wahin qabr banana
hai waqt wasiyat ko nibhao
taboot uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaun bhala saaya e dewaar banega
bewa'on yateemon ka madadgaar banega
kufe ke ghareebon ko batao
taboot uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ekkeeswi ramzan qayamat ka tha manzar
thi zainab e muztar ki sada mesum o mazhar
ab kaise jiyun koi batao
taboot uth raha hai...
author: Mazhar Abidi
